name: IconQA: A Benchmark for Abstract Diagram Understanding
description: IconQA is a visual question answering and abstract diagram reasoning benchmark comprising 107,440 questions (reported as 107,439 in narrative text; exact split sum across official train 64,462, val 21,489, test 21,489 is 107,440) across 96,817 icon images. Sourced from elementary school curricula, it features three official sub-tasks: multi-image-choice (57,672), multi-text-choice (31,578), and filling-in-the-blank (18,189). Companion icon classification pretraining resources are separately released in Icon645 (645,687 icons).
